message:
Structural Dynamicist and Serviceability and Crowd Loading Specialist, the device stays invisible from deck eye height with no change to walking feel.

The retrofit lives fully below the walking surface with no change to parapet, floor or sightlines. The Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass moving out of phase with the deck, uses moving mass 800 kg per the Den Hartog sizing (E11) and total hung load 9.81 kN per the hung load estimate (E29), about thirteen body weights and a washing-machine cube, tucked between girders per the midspan layout sketch (E12).

Retrofit and Maintenance Engineer and the Manager, the device hides behind a girder-colour screen with fixed and moving parts separated and room to move. Fixed parts are cross-beam, clamps and perforated screen, moving parts are springs plus damper plus mass free only vertically, with zero millimetres above the walking surface per the under-deck recessed cassette sketch (E30), and stroke 2.52 mm inside plus-minus 30.0 mm clearance per the damped response sweep (E32), fingernail travel that fits a shallow cassette, while damped peak 0.106 m/s2 is about 0.0108 g like a still floor.

Not ready, because appearance is frozen but the blocking clamp slip proof remains open.
